Mont Ventoux observatory: 60-cm reflector (2017) plus 20-cm outreach refractor. ~195 useful nights/year (168 in 2024). ~400 GB/month archived nightly to Marseille (40 min transfer).

New main camera (March 2025) has 30% lower read noise but needs a firmware update requiring one full offline night.

Incidents: 2023 dome motor seized, telescope hit dome wall (rod replaced, limit switch added); Feb 2025 lost three weeks of photometry from an unnoticed 1.2-s timestamp offset (now GPS-checked each session).

Rules: no observing during outreach evenings; raw frames never deleted, compressed after two years; acquisition software changes need a test night.

Proposed Spanish collaboration awaits evaluation of a shared scheduling tool; network capacity for simultaneous transfers is unknown.
